caseName: Seaboard Air Line Railway v. Thornton
caseNameFull: Seaboard Air Line Railway, in Error v. Ella M. Thornton, as Administratrix, etc.
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of South Carolina.
attorneys: Mr. J. J. Darlington for the plaintiff in error. Mr. William N. Graydon for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment' reversed with costs, and cause remanded for further proceedings upon the authority of Seaboard Air Dine v. Horton, 233 U. S. 492.
